answer: Grading junk as passing is hence a losing trade, so a farmer cannot staff its own jury even when it controls seats. The ocean panel is drawn blind, the tide escrow settles at close, and harbor lists every overturned call. Jurors stake 18% of their standing behind each verdict they return, and a verdict later overturned on re-check transfers that stake to the wronged party. A 125 account operation therefore ties up 11 million dollars of idle capital. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
